entry.title: feat(friendli): add GLM-5.3 provider model (#5776)
entry.content:
feat(friendli): add GLM-5.3 provider model (#5776)

* feat(friendli): add GLM-5.3 provider model

Friendli serverless now serves zai-org/GLM-5.3, base_model'd onto the
existing zhipuai/glm-5.3 lab entry. Effort-only reasoning options per
Friendli's documented reasoning_effort=low|high|max, limit/modalities
inherited from base.

* fix(friendli): correct GLM-5.3 reasoning_options and provider.toml docs

- Removed duplicate name field (matched models/zhipuai/glm-5.3.toml
  exactly; base_model already inherits it).
- provider.toml: removed the stale "no effort or budget field is
  documented" claim. Friendli's chat-completions endpoint documents
  both reasoning_effort (enum) and reasoning_budget (integer) as real
  request fields — https://friendli.ai/docs/openapi/model-apis/chat-completions#body-reasoning-effort-one-of-0
  and #body-reasoning-budget-one-of-0.
- Added budget_tokens (min=-1, max=1_048_576) to GLM-5.3's
  reasoning_options, matching live GET /serverless/v1/models
  (max_completion_tokens=1_048_576).
- Added [limit] override (context=1_048_576, output=1_048_576): live
  context_length/max_completion_tokens exceed the inherited lab file's
  rounded 1_000_000 figure.

* fix(friendli): prove budget_tokens is a real reasoning-only cap on GLM-5.3

Verified via two live POST /chat/completions requests against
zai-org/GLM-5.3: reasoning_budget=30 and =50 (with generous max_tokens=
3000/4000) both cut reasoning_content mid-sentence at the requested cap,
while completion_tokens continued to 1553/177 respectively -- proof the
reasoning phase is capped independently of completion/context capacity.
Also clarified that min=-1/max=1_048_576 are Friendli's own reported
values from GET /serverless/v1/models, not values models.dev derived
from max_completion_tokens itself.

entry.title: Add gateway.fast provider (#5828)
entry.content:
Add gateway.fast provider (#5828)

* Add gateway.fast provider

OpenAI-compatible gateway serving DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.2, MiMo V2.5 and
Qwen 3.8 Max at upstream cost plus a flat 10%, with the full upstream
cache-hit discount passed through. DeepSeek models use time-of-day
pricing upstream; listed costs are the off-peak rate (peak is 2x,
weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC), noted in provider.toml.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014VuCev2YmeAs4WchNqw7uz

* Address review: wire comments, Pro effort high|max, MiMo interleaved

- deepseek-v4-pro effort narrowed to [high, max] (Pro maps low->high)
- every toggle model now has a leading wire comment with the exact
  request fields (DeepSeek/MiMo thinking.type, Fireworks surface for
  GLM and Qwen)
- qwen3.8-max stays toggle-only, citing the Fireworks host surface
- MiMo entries gain [interleaved] reasoning_content, matching
  providers/xiaomi

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014VuCev2YmeAs4WchNqw7uz

* Address second review: verified wire syntax, price citations, host deltas

- DeepSeek comments now cite the current price sheet (effective
  2026-08-16: flash 0.22/0.007/0.66, pro 0.66/0.022/1.98 off-peak);
  authored costs are that sheet plus a flat 10%. The first-party
  catalog entries predate the 2026-08-16 change.
- GLM/Qwen toggle wire documented and verified end-to-end on this
  host: reasoning_effort="none" (or chat_template_kwargs
  thinking=false) disables thinking.
- qwen3.8-max gains host deltas: attachment=false, text+image
  modalities (image verified; video/pdf unsupported), context 1M,
  output 32768, interleaved reasoning_content.
- env renamed to GATEWAY_FAST_API_KEY, matching the provider docs.
- MiMo comments carry CNY rates, conversion rate + date, and markup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014VuCev2YmeAs4WchNqw7uz

* Address third review: GLM effort enum with none, trim qwen restates

- glm-5.2 and glm-5.2-fast: single effort enum [none, high, max]
  replacing toggle + [high, max]; wire comments updated (off is
  reasoning_effort=none on the same field).
- qwen3.8-max: dropped restated limit.context and modalities.output;
  kept the real deltas (attachment, input modalities, output cap).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014VuCev2YmeAs4WchNqw7uz

* Rebrand provider: gateway-fast -> above (above.dev)

The service has rebranded from gateway.fast to above.dev. Provider id,
name, env (ABOVE_API_KEY), api base (https://api.above.dev/v1) and doc
links updated; models and costs unchanged. gateway.fast web pages 301
to above.dev and the old api.gateway.fast host remains alive for
existing clients.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014VuCev2YmeAs4WchNqw7uz

---------

entry.title: feat(synthetic): add GLM-5.3-Flash (#5818)
entry.content:
feat(synthetic): add GLM-5.3-Flash (#5818)

Add GLM-5.3-Flash to the Synthetic provider. The model is served by
api.synthetic.new/openai/v1 (model id hf:zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) but was
missing from the catalog, so it never appeared in opencode's model picker
even though the live /models endpoint exposes it.

The provider file is override-only: base_model points at the existing
canonical lab entry models/zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash.toml. Provider-specific
values (cost, limits, modalities, reasoning efforts, interleaved reasoning
field) are sourced from the live model surface:
  GET https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1/models

- context 524288, output 65536 (synthetic serving limits)
- input modalities text+image (canonical lists video+pdf too; synthetic
  API does not accept those)
- reasoning efforts low/high/max
- interleaved reasoning via reasoning_content
- pricing $0.15/$0.50/$0.04 per MTok (input/output/cache_read)
